instrument.name: BAD HAND 2
instrument.description:
BAD HAND 2 is a collection of 1/1 collage trading cards by Moldy created with new and vintage magazines, comics, catalogs, original illustration and graffiti on a variety of Pokemon cards. 
Claim your card to redeem the physical! 
Use the BAD HAND 2 redeem page on VVV to verify which physicals have been claimed.
